en: “It's okay, I want you to stop by more often.”
“I made some chocolate cookies, if you want some?”
“I found this when I was cleaning, I figured I should give it to you.”
“Oh... You know, it's okay for you to compliment me~”
“Wow... You must be, like, super smart.”
“That's great. I'm sure six months off won't affect you at all.”
“Yeah, but I still need to review.”
“After all, when I go back next year, I'm going to have to catch up.”
“Don't forget to relax every so often. Otherwise, it'll be counterproductive.”
“Okay! I'm gonna relax for a bit!”
Shizuku takes out a few textbooks.
“Are you worried I'm too stupid, Shizuku?”
“Um... Teacher, my grades at high school weren't that good...”
I spend some time learning from Miss Shizuku.
